C0885.title: Bo Software Company Illegally Harvests Hospital Appointment User Privacy Case
C0885.summary: Between 2015 and 2020, Bo Software Co., Ltd., while developing and maintaining an online appointment system for a hospital, illegally obtained and stored over 2.87 million pieces of personal information belonging to appointment users.
